content.trans: 我认为我是在某处读到过，切肉丝其实是粤菜中的一种，可能曾经是某种中国的菜肴。

content.text: came from all of the leftovers and garbage in the kitchen.
content.trans: 厨房里剩下的垃圾都成了我的原材料。

content.text: We would just fry it together and it was a cheap, easy meal.
content.trans: 我们只是把它煮在一起，结果是一顿廉价又简单的饭。

content.text: So chop sui, it's kind of like an English, it's like a pigeon English.
content.trans: 所以切生菜，这有点像英文，就像鸽子英语。

content.text: Well this dish is basically that, right?
content.trans: 这个菜基本上就是这样，对吧？

content.text: It's just a lot of meat, meat chunks mixed with some vegetables and you have some chop sui.
content.trans: 这不过是一堆肉，肉块和一些蔬菜的混合物，你有一些炒菜。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: There are also these other things that's very common people think about fortune cookies.
content.trans: 还有这些其他的事情，是很多人认为与“福袋饼干”有关的。

content.text: Do you think of Chinese restaurants and Chinese food, do you think of fortune cookies?
content.trans: 你是否联想到中国餐馆和中国菜，是否联想到酥皮饼干？

content.text: That's right, but they don't have fortune cookies in China.
content.trans: 那是对的，但中国没有福橘。

content.text: No, they don't.
content.trans: No，他们不。

content.text: One of my biggest disappointments.
content.trans: 我的一大失望。

content.text: So fortune cookie is a small cookie with a message inside.
content.trans: 所以，乌龙饼是一种带有内附祝福语的小饼干。

content.text: A message inside, so you have a piece of paper.
content.trans: 这是一个内部附带的信息，所以你有一张纸。

content.text: So you be careful when you're eating these.
content.trans: 所以你吃饭的时候要小心。

content.text: You don't want to eat a paper.
content.trans: 你不想吃一张纸。

content.text: But the paper sometimes says very strange things.
content.trans: 但纸有时候会说一些非常奇怪的话。

content.text: Like, you will have a terrific number seven.
content.trans: Like，你会有一个很棒的七号。

content.text: Right, or something like that.
content.trans: 好的，或者那样。

content.text: So that's why they're fortune cookies.
content.trans: 所以这就是为什么他们吃的是幸运饼干。

content.text: They usually talk about your future or what you're talking about.
content.trans: 他们通常谈论你的未来或你正在谈论的内容。

content.text: Beware of whales.
content.trans: 小心鲸鱼。

content.text: So, but that's also an American invention that doesn't exist in China.
content.trans: 所以，但这也是一种美国发明，中国却没有。

content.text: It doesn't really come from China, right?
content.trans: 它不是真的来自中国，对吧？

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So if you have any other information about food or we're always glad to hear it.
content.trans: 所以，如果你有任何关于食物的其他信息，我们都非常乐意听到。

content.text: Because we're always hungry.
content.trans: 因为我们总是饿的。

content.text: Or if you have a favorite Chinese food, please let us know.
content.trans: 如果你有最喜欢的中国食物，请告诉我们。

content.text: Our website is engluchpod.com.
content.trans: 我们的网站是engluchpod.com。

content.text: We can't wait to hear from you and we will talk to you next time.
content.trans: 我们迫不及待地想听到你的消息，下次见时再聊。

content.text: All right, bye.
content.trans: 好的，再见。
